bullets.text: Slower Apple Features Ahead - **Apple** warns UK users of potential delays in feature rollouts due to new regulations.
UK Government's iCloud Access Demand - The UK government seeks backdoor access to **Apple's** iCloud, raising privacy concerns.
Honor Magic V5 Launches - The **Honor Magic V5** foldable phone debuts in the UK, boasting impressive durability and slim design.
Apple Comedy on BBC - **Apple TV+** series 'Trying' to air on **BBC**, expanding its audience in the UK.
Crash Detection Saves Life - An **iPhone** feature successfully alerted emergency services after a teen fell asleep at the wheel.
Apple's Legal Battles - **Apple** fights legal challenges in the UK over 4G patent fees, impacting its global pricing strategy.
iPhone 17 Pro Rumors - Anticipation builds for the **iPhone 17 Pro**, featuring new designs and enhanced performance.
WhatsApp Security Flaw Fixed - **WhatsApp** addresses a serious security bug that targeted **Apple** users with spyware.
Meta's Chatbot Safety Update - **Meta** updates chatbot rules to enhance safety for teen users, avoiding sensitive topics.
Framework's GPU Upgrade Success - **Framework** successfully demonstrates a modular laptop with swappable GPUs in minutes.
